Reference / archive/path

archive/path#

Immutable relative archive member name, independent of fs/Path and the host.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let entry = ArchivePath("assets/иконка.png");
entry.name();            // "иконка.png"
entry.parent().string(); // "assets"

Description#

Immutable relative archive member name, independent of fs/Path and the host. The constructor rejects empty/absolute paths, any backslash or NUL, leading ASCII drive prefixes (including C:relative), and empty, . or .. segments. Slash is the only separator. Trailing slash is an empty segment: directory kind and wire-format suffix handling belong to the archive format adapter. No trimming, normalization, case folding, percent decoding or path cleanup. Valid Unicode and ordinary punctuation are retained exactly. A colon outside a leading drive prefix is ordinary archive text, not a portability promise.

string() reconstructs the exact validated name; segments() returns immutable components. parent() of one segment throws MissingArchiveParent.path(...), never a synthetic empty/root path. All observations are pure; no owned resources. This is lexical validation only: link traversal, host-specific restrictions and destination containment/races belong to the later extraction capability.
